{{/* MDFriday-hosted BeerCSS base URL (no jsDelivr). params.mdfriday.beerCdn overrides; else host follows theme asset CDN + beerVersion. */}} {{- $mdf := index .Site.Params "mdfriday" | default dict -}} {{- $ver := index $mdf "beerVersion" | default "5.0.5" -}} {{- with index $mdf "beerCdn" -}} {{- . -}} {{- else -}} {{- $asset := partial "asset" "css/layout.css" | strings.TrimSpace -}} {{- $host := "https://cdn.fsky.top" -}} {{- if hasPrefix $asset "https://cdn.mdfriday.com" -}} {{- $host = "https://cdn.mdfriday.com" -}} {{- else if hasPrefix $asset "https://cdn.fsky.top" -}} {{- $host = "https://cdn.fsky.top" -}} {{- end -}} {{- printf "%s/v/beercss/%s/" $host $ver -}} {{- end -}}
